name: David Crockett State Park - Campground 2
waterfront_evidence: not waterfront (2026-11-24): Campground 2's loops (sites 46-97) sit on a wooded hilltop at ~290 m (3DEP), Esri World Imagery z17/z18 at 35.2597,-87.3612 (rendered) shows RVs among continuous woods with no stream, pond or lake beside any loop; the official campground map (https://tnstateparks.com/sites/default/files/2025-10/David_Crockett_Campground_web.png) draws no water near Campground 2. Shoal Creek is ~1.7 km east at Campground 1.
inclusion_evidence: https://tnstateparks.com/parks/david-crockett/camping (read 2026-11-24): 'Campground #2 features paved campsites, each equipped with electric and water hook-ups. Campground #2 is open year-round.'; reserve.tnstateparks.com/david-crockett/campsites: 52 bookable drive-in sites 46-97, all back-in paved pads 40-57 ft with 20/30/50-amp and water -> real drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits
note: Campground 2 is three loops of paved pads on a wooded hilltop, about 1.7 km west of Campground 1 on Shoal Creek. Sites 46, 47 and 97 are ADA sites that need a disability ID or plates to book. --Claude

fees.note: $38 a night on weeknights and $43-44 on weekends on the dates read through June 2027; $41 on weeknights and $45 on weekends from July 2027. Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends $65.

hookups.source: https://reserve.tnstateparks.com/david-crockett/campsites (Calendar View, every site's price and availability for two weeks from 2026-11-25, 2027-01-12, 2027-02-24, 2027-03-16, 2027-05-25, 2027-06-29, 2027-09-01 and 2027-10-27), read 2026-11-24 (Campground 2 sites 46-97: every site '20 Amp, 30 Amp, 50 Amp', water Yes, sewer No); https://tnstateparks.com/parks/david-crockett/camping ('Campground 2 has all 20-30-50 amp electric hookups'), read 2026-11-24

_reasons: Two campgrounds ~1.74 km apart centroid to centroid, each its own loop road off the park road: Campground 1 (sites 1-45, seasonal, on Shoal Creek) and Campground 2 (sites 46-97, year-round, hilltop). 4392 kept on Campground 2 (larger, 52 of 96 sites; matches the stored year_round; stored pin was 669 m from it vs 1,228 m from Campground 1). No trip references.
